business_problem: Accenture wanted an AI assistant that could operate inside its highly customized sales process, handle complex tagging and coaching workflows, and prove the value of Agentforce before a broad rollout across a 55,000-seller organization.
solution_summary: Accenture is piloting Agentforce inside its global sales organization as a 'customer zero' deployment that sits directly on top of its existing Salesforce sales architecture and custom data model. The company adapted Agentforce to internal concepts such as Marketing Units and service-line tagging so the agent can work against Accenture's real database layer instead of a generic out-of-the-box schema. That lets Agentforce either guide sellers through complex workflows like creating a missing sales tag or complete the tagging workflow itself, while another sales-coaching use case stays with a seller from RFP creation through live client interactions. All proposal and opportunity data already flows through Sales Cloud and a BI layer, so leaders can query the pipeline for patterns and learn from the pilot's thumbs-up and thumbs-down feedback loop before deciding how to scale the deployment globally.
data_flow: Opportunity, proposal, and interaction data flows through Sales Cloud and Accenture's BI layer into Salesforce, where Agentforce reads the custom sales model, automates tagging, coaches sellers, and improves from explicit user feedback during the pilot.
business_outcome: Accenture simplified complex sales-governance tasks, created an AI coaching layer for sellers, and built a live pilot that can validate accuracy and adoption before a broader enterprise rollout.
architecture_clues: Accenture customized Agentforce to understand internal Marketing Unit fields and service-line tags.
100% of deal proposals and opportunity management data flows through the Sales Cloud org.
Pilot feedback is collected through immediate thumbs-up and thumbs-down responses.
evidence_quotes: We define Marketing Units (MUs) as a geography. But out of the box, the MU field was not recognized by Agentforce, so we had to customize it.
With Agentforce, the AI agent can either guide them like a trusted coworker or automatically take on the tagging workflow.
Our pilot is 2,200 users ... We have 55,000 sellers.
We also have an Agentforce sales coach that stays with a seller throughout the lifecycle - from request for proposal (RFP) to real-time client interactions.
